system.description: After an enemy resolves an Attack, Objective, Skill or Spell action, discard up to (SL + 1) cards that are jokers or match the action's suit (Attack ice, Objective fire, Skill earth, Spell air), draw back, then perform the Spell action for free, casting a spell of (SL × 5) MP or less — you still pay the MP. Once per round.
